label: Malkin 2013
setting: 28 private and hospital-based outpatient low vision rehabilitation centres
diagnosis_mix: macular disorders 55% (non-neovascular AMD 26%, neovascular 12%, other macular 17%) in the parent study; subset breakdown NR
recruitment: 77 consecutive participants (of 764 in parent study) who had EQ-5D collected late in the study; new LVR patients aged 18+, English telephone interview; 2008-2011
cohort: subset of 77 of 764 patients in the LOVRNET parent study (Goldstein 2012, ref 25)
notes: Responsiveness study, not a screening-accuracy study; no sens/spec. Median age 77 (Table 1 p3). Baseline and follow-up telephone interviews 6-9 months apart. Visual acuity only as categories in Table 1 (EQ-5D subset: profound 10%, severe 26%, moderate 34%, mild 30%); no reference standard used. n_items blank-equivalent NR: EQ-5D has 5 items, AI is adaptive (510-item bank).
